title: Genesis Alert Raised Event
description: Something needs the operator's attention: a desk asked for help, the model gateway failed, or a private-content guard fired. One fact per alert. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (genesis).
$comment: No access keys, tickets, tokens, sealed grants or operator notes in data, and never a full message body: body_preview is the most it carries.

correlationid.description: UUID, the base envelope requires one. uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'urn:33god:genesis:alert:<data.alert_id>').

client_id.description: The client the fact is about.

client_name.description: The client's display name, as the operator sees it. Runtime data only.

bot_id.description: The desk that caused the fact, '<client_id>:<role>', or 'genesis' when the front desk raised it.

summary.description: One line a notification can show as-is.

operator_url.description: Operator surface page for this client.

test.description: True on synthetic events from test clients; consumers label them.

alert_id.description: This alert. The envelope correlationid is derived from it.

reason.description: Why it was raised. Known values: operator_requested, gateway_failure, private_content_blocked, private_content_leaked. Open for new reasons.

detail.description: What happened, in prose a person can act on.
